name: moon
description: A balanced crescent moon with a clean circular concavity in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The filled exterior is the analytical .85-unit outward offset of the revised Outline at Regular 1.70: outer radius 8.85, concave radius 8.15, and radius-.85 joins centered on the original horns. The radius-9 Outline concavity is offset toward its own center by .85; the outer circle center, horn endpoints and native translation are retained. The shallower concavity follows the owner request to pull the inner arc toward the artboard center. No style-specific scaling or translation is used. Native X/Y=100% and rotation=0 are the reference. Compare contours at equal rotation. Draft awaiting owner review.
